meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会产出地理空间相关的代码和分步操作，涵盖遥感影像、矢量/栅格数据、空间统计、点云、网络分析等，能按 Python、R、Julia 等 8 种语言给出 500 多个示例代码。
howto.when: 当用户提出遥感、GIS 分析、空间机器学习等地理空间计算任务时触发；例如处理卫星影像、做空间连接、搜索 STAC 数据等。

say.text: 帮我用 Sentinel-2 影像算这个区域的 NDVI
用 GeoPandas 把这两份 GeoJSON 做空间连接并统计

say.text: 从 Planetary Computer 搜索 2023 年旧金山无云的哨兵影像

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will produce geospatial code and step-by-step operations, covering remote sensing imagery, vector/raster data, spatial statistics, point clouds, network analysis, with 500+ code examples in 8 languages including Python, R, and Julia.
howto.when_en: It triggers when users request geospatial computation tasks such as remote sensing, GIS analysis, or spatial ML—for example processing satellite imagery, doing spatial joins, or searching STAC data.

say_en.text: Help me compute NDVI for this area from Sentinel-2 imagery
say_en.note: Claude will give code to read bands and calculate NDVI with rasterio

say_en.text: Use GeoPandas to spatial-join these two GeoJSON files and summarize
